title: Stockfish, But 5% Chance of Blundering Every Move
summary: 'Blunderfish': Stockfish with a 5% chance of blundering on any given move. Player (white) plays solid, symmetrical, principled chess for a long game, waiting for a real blunder; after a long, mostly equal middlegame the bot eventually errs, the player converts with a double pawn promotion and a ladder mate to win game 1.
rules: Each bot move: with probability 5% it blunders, otherwise plays Stockfish's best move.
Official site: a blunder = a uniformly random legal move other than the engine's best move.
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1 (ladder mate).
